purpose: build the self-contained GPU environment for the UI art upscaler in <work>\art_build (embeddable Python, torch cu130, spandrel, pinned models); nothing system-wide
usage: upscale\pc\setup_env.cmd [work folder, default C:\napoleon_remastered_pc\upscale]   then: <work>\art_build\py\python.exe upscale\pc\env_check.py --models <work>\art_build\models --pins upscale\napoleon\models.json
when: first use on a PC, or after deleting art_build; safe to re-run (finished downloads are skipped)
not_a_verb: a Windows setup script; `wsc upscale env` runs the check it ends with
